big_case.notes: The abstract question (whether McDonnell Douglas burden-shifting belongs at Rule 56 summary judgment in Title VII cases) matters to employment-discrimination litigation nationwide and drew four cert-stage amicus briefs and a call for response. But the vehicle was a fact-bound challenge to an unpublished Ninth Circuit memorandum in a single-employee discharge against a local transit agency, with no alleged circuit split, and the Court denied without any noted dissent at the first post-opposition conference. Modest stakes as presented.
